    cases Hnorm

      simp_all
    apply List.Subset.app

      apply tih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih1 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih2 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
